ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.17 adds bounded-risk parallel Work prefiltering for exact Vanilla GrowerSow, GrowerHarvest and BuildRoof cell scanners. Vanilla still enumerates and orders the current scan normally; RimMT records those cells and lets the validated eight-worker scheduler classify a narrow whitelist of read-only hard-negative conditions for later scans. Workers never create Jobs, reserve targets or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map state. Unknown and positive candidates remain Vanilla-authoritative, while negative hints use warmup validation, periodic parity sampling, per-kind cooldown and a global false-negative fuse. V0.4.16 aggressive Reachability, full CanReach Harmony census, VFE Phasing / Pathfinding Framework / Hospitality coexistence, persistent map search, hauling accelerators, path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
